driver-gloves-crimson-weave.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Crimson Weave
driver-gloves-crimson-weave.desc:
These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. Black suede has been interwoven with scarlet leather to give these gloves a timeless look.

Leave your mark, not your fingerprints

sport-gloves-scarlet-shamagh.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh
sport-gloves-scarlet-shamagh.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

bloodhound-gloves-snakebite.name: ★ Bloodhound Gloves | Snakebite
bloodhound-gloves-snakebite.desc:
These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Bloodhound logo. It was crafted with a mix of leather and snakeskin.

Let's be honest... no one misses Sergei - Hans Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

aug-eye-of-zapems.name: AUG | Eye of Zapems
aug-eye-of-zapems.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted with custom graffiti from Zapems, the infamous street graffiti artist from Overpass.

"Check the cameras, we need to find who's doing this"

awp-exoskeleton.name: AWP | Exoskeleton
awp-exoskeleton.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. The metal on this AWP has been intricately pressed with patterns of interlocking skulls.

Full tilt

bayonet-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
bayonet-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bayonet-scorched.name: ★ Bayonet | Scorched
bayonet-scorched.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

pp-bizon-judgement-of-anubis.name: PP-Bizon | Judgement of Anubis
pp-bizon-judgement-of-anubis.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted in an Egyptian theme.

Its trigger weighs lighter than a feather

dual-berettas-melondrama.name: Dual Berettas | Melondrama
dual-berettas-melondrama.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. These berettas have been custom painted with a twisted, frightening depiction of a watermelon over a navy blue background.

Sweet dreams...

dual-berettas-balance.name: Dual Berettas | Balance
dual-berettas-balance.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. A red rose has been painted on either grip over a black base and silver filigree.

In all things

famas-prime-conspiracy.name: FAMAS | Prime Conspiracy
famas-prime-conspiracy.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do

famas-night-borre.name: FAMAS | Night Borre
famas-night-borre.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray-painted with a Norse inspired pattern of interlocking blue rings.

"It is better to fight and fall than to live without hope"

five-seven-nightshade.name: Five-SeveN | Nightshade
five-seven-nightshade.desc: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted using a hydrographic with a floral pattern in the style of the Arts and Crafts movement.

g3sg1-orange-kimono.name: G3SG1 | Orange Kimono
g3sg1-orange-kimono.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a geometric motif.

Tradition is a powerful thing

g3sg1-safari-mesh.name: G3SG1 | Safari Mesh
g3sg1-safari-mesh.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

galil-ar-orange-ddpat.name: Galil AR | Orange DDPAT
galil-ar-orange-ddpat.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

glock-18-teal-graf.name: Glock-18 | Teal Graf
glock-18-teal-graf.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A blue and red hydrographic graffiti pattern has been applied.

Dot your "t"s and cross your "i"s

paracord-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Slaughter
paracord-knife-slaughter.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

classic-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Classic Knife | Slaughter
classic-knife-slaughter.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

flip-knife-fade.name: ★ Flip Knife | Fade
flip-knife-fade.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

gut-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Gut Knife | Damascus Steel
gut-knife-damascus-steel.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has some damascus steel parts.

navaja-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Marble Fade
navaja-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

karambit-bright-water.name: ★ Karambit | Bright Water
karambit-bright-water.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Doppler
m9-bayonet-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m9-bayonet-tiger-tooth.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Tiger Tooth
m9-bayonet-tiger-tooth.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

nomad-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Marble Fade
nomad-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler
shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-scorched.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Scorched
shadow-daggers-scorched.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Doppler
skeleton-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Tiger Tooth
skeleton-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

bowie-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Boreal Forest
bowie-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

huntsman-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Forest DDPAT
huntsman-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

ursus-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel
ursus-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has some damascus steel parts.

m249-emerald-poison-dart.name: M249 | Emerald Poison Dart
m249-emerald-poison-dart.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been painted using a hydrographic inspired by a poison dart frog.

Conservation is not a priority

m4a4-steel-work.name: M4A4 | Steel Work
m4a4-steel-work.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. Its worn steel base is finished with red ribbons and a matching red grip and magazine.

It's on site!

m4a4-faded-zebra.name: M4A4 | Faded Zebra
m4a4-faded-zebra.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.

mac-10-heat.name: MAC-10 | Heat
mac-10-heat.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted to look as though it just came out of the forge.

Make some outlines of your own

mag-7-rust-coat.name: MAG-7 | Rust Coat
mag-7-rust-coat.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

mag-7-copper-coated.name: MAG-7 | Copper Coated
mag-7-copper-coated.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to look like it was held under a stream of liquid copper.

This was an accident, not a mistake...

mag-7-magnitude.name: MAG-7 | MAGnitude
mag-7-magnitude.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. This custom paint job gives the appearance of a shockwave emanating from the bolt above the trigger.

Two point oh

mp7-orange-peel.name: MP7 | Orange Peel
mp7-orange-peel.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

mp9-dart.name: MP9 | Dart
mp9-dart.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted using a striped hydrographic arranged in a chevron pattern.

Throw enough downfield and you're bound to hit the bullseye eventually

mp9-broken-record.name: MP9 | Broken Record
mp9-broken-record.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted to resemble a vinyl record, grooves and all.

Instant classic

negev-sour-grapes.name: Negev | Sour Grapes
negev-sour-grapes.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted using different shades of purple.

Purple people deleter

nova-dark-sigil.name: Nova | Dark Sigil
nova-dark-sigil.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted with longships and dragons.

It emerged from the fog of war

p90-off-world.name: P90 | Off World
p90-off-world.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been hand painted with multiple coats of blue paint; even more than last time.

This topcoat may never dry…

p90-shallow-grave.name: P90 | Shallow Grave
p90-shallow-grave.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. The grips have been painted to resemble rune stones, and a hydrographic of a skeleton has been applied to the stock.

With the amount of bodies you're racking up, who has time to dig?

sawed-off-highwayman.name: Sawed-Off | Highwayman
sawed-off-highwayman.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been lacquered in black and gold using a scotch thistle motif.

You don't have to hold your pinky out when pulling the trigger, but it's a nice touch

sawed-off-mosaico.name: Sawed-Off | Mosaico
sawed-off-mosaico.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. This memento from Ali has been painted with a mosaic hydrographic.

Patience is a virtue

sawed-off-forest-ddpat.name: Sawed-Off | Forest DDPAT
sawed-off-forest-ddpat.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

scar-20-grotto.name: SCAR-20 | Grotto
scar-20-grotto.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been sponged and brush-painted with blue metallic effect paints.

The founder of Season Corporation had this piece commissioned after being rescued by renowned Operator Kotaro Izaki

sg-553-darkwing.name: SG 553 | Darkwing
sg-553-darkwing.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. A red and black custom paint job with feathers and other dark details has been applied.

Eagle eyed and extremely lethal; you won't find a more dangerous flightless bird

ssg-08-blue-spruce.name: SSG 08 | Blue Spruce
ssg-08-blue-spruce.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a moss color scheme.

tec-9-garter-9.name: Tec-9 | Garter-9
tec-9-garter-9.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A green snakeskin pattern has been applied.

Crush and kill

tec-9-perimeter.name: Tec-9 | Perimeter
tec-9-perimeter.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A multicolored design of Xs, squares, and dots has been applied.

Drawing up the X's and O's

ump-45-day-lily.name: UMP-45 | Day Lily
ump-45-day-lily.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A hydrographic pattern of red lilies has been applied.

While beautiful, lilies are most often associated with death

ump-45-green-swirl.name: UMP-45 | Green Swirl
ump-45-green-swirl.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A green and tan pattern has been applied.

Some of our goals aren't... aligned

ump-45-delusion.name: UMP-45 | Delusion
ump-45-delusion.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been screen printed with a nautilus design.

Carcosa is calling

ump-45-ko-factory.name: UMP-45 | K.O. Factory
ump-45-ko-factory.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. This custom paint job is inspired by old animation cartoons.

Swing and a miss!

ump-45-late-night-transit.name: UMP-45 | Late Night Transit
ump-45-late-night-transit.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with fictitious transit diagrams designed around the maps of Counter-Strike.

"Now arriving at green line stop number four, Dust II"

usp-s-orange-anolis.name: USP-S | Orange Anolis
usp-s-orange-anolis.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A red and gold lizard scale pattern has been applied.

Painted to scale

usp-s-monster-mashup.name: USP-S | Monster Mashup
usp-s-monster-mashup.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A custom paint job featuring a green monster and other icons inspired by popular urban art has been applied. The silencer has a pearlescent finish.

X__X

usp-s-lead-conduit.name: USP-S | Lead Conduit
usp-s-lead-conduit.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been given a custom engraved silencer and slide.

You got what you wanted, now do you know what that means? – Booth, Arms Dealer

usp-s-overgrowth.name: USP-S | Overgrowth
usp-s-overgrowth.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. This memento from Siege has been painted using a camo hydrographic.

Look me in the eyes and tell me that's standard issue - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

usp-s-spiral-glitch.name: USP-S | Spiral Glitch
usp-s-spiral-glitch.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. Disruptive designs have been custom painted beneath a topcoat of pearlescent paint.

They won't know what hit 'em

xm1014-blue-steel.name: XM1014 | Blue Steel
xm1014-blue-steel.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

gut-knife.name: ★ Gut Knife
gut-knife.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease.

ursus-knife.name: ★ Ursus Knife
ursus-knife.desc: This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work.
